Done in a single execution.

- `out/T3/solution.py` loads all 114 tensors from the sharded input, casts exactly the 112 projection matrices (anchored regex on `model.layers.<i>.{self_attn.[qkvo]_proj,mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj}.weight`) to bfloat16, leaves everything else float32, deletes nothing, and renames nothing.
- All four required checks run before any write; a dtype sweep also asserts every non-bf16 tensor is float32.
- Output: 10 shards + `model.safetensors.index.json`. `lm_head.weight` and `model.embed_tokens.weight` (412 MB each) sit alone in their own shards; the other 8 shards hold 14 tensors at exactly 268,435,456 bytes each. Total 114 tensors, 2,971,664,384 bytes.
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` written.

One unspecified point I chose for: the reference's shard naming and key ordering aren't given, so I used sorted key order with `model-{i:05d}-of-{n:05d}.safetensors`.
